*:not(div,p,span,ul,li,i,span) { background-color: var(--deep); color: var(--beach); font-family: var(--font-sans); }

body { width: 100vw; height: 100vh; justify-content: center; align-items: center; }

#info { display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1em; }

#errorTrace-wrapper { position: relative; width: fit-content; }
#copy-button { position: absolute; top: 0.5em; right: 0.5em; padding: 0.23em; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.4s; font-size: 0.9em; }

<script> window.activeProxyEngine = 'scramjet'; window.scramjetEndpoint = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mercuryworkshop/scramjet@2.0.0-alpha/dist/'; window.uvEndpoint = 'https://uv.holyunblocker.org/service/'; window.currentProxyUrl = '';
window.encodeUvUrl = function(url) { if (!url) return ''; return encodeURIComponent( url.split('').map((char, ind) => ind % 2 ? String.fromCharCode(char.charCodeAt(0) ^ 2) : char ).join('') ); };
window.onProxyFrameLoaded = function() { const loader = document.getElementById('loading-screen'); if (loader) { loader.classList.add('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none'); setTimeout(() => { loader.style.display = 'none'; }, 300); } };
window.showLoadingScreen = function(urlText) { const loader = document.getElementById('loading-screen'); const targetLabel = document.getElementById('loading-target-url'); if (loader) { if (targetLabel) targetLabel.textContent = urlText || 'Connecting...'; loader.style.display = 'flex'; void loader.offsetWidth; loader.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none'); } };
window.historyBack = function() { window.goHome(); };
window.goHome = function() { const proxyContainer = document.getElementById('proxy-container'); const homeView = document.getElementById('home-view'); const svgContainer = document.getElementById('svg-render-container');
if (proxyContainer && homeView) { proxyContainer.classList.add('hidden'); homeView.classList.remove('hidden'); } if (svgContainer) { svgContainer.innerHTML = ''; } window.currentProxyUrl = ''; const topInput = document.getElementById('top-url-input'); if (topInput) topInput.value = ''; };
window.reloadProxy = function() { if (window.currentProxyUrl) { window.launchProxyByUrl(window.currentProxyUrl); } };
window.toggleSettingsModal = function(show) { const dropdown = document.getElementById('settings-dropdown'); if (!dropdown) return;
const isShowing = show !== undefined ? show : dropdown.classList.contains('hidden');
if (isShowing) { dropdown.classList.remove('hidden'); void dropdown.offsetWidth; dropdown.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'scale-95', 'translate-y-[-10px]', 'pointer-events-none'); dropdown.classList.add('opacity-100', 'scale-100', 'translate-y-0'); } else { dropdown.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'scale-100', 'translate-y-0'); dropdown.classList.add('opacity-0', 'scale-95', 'translate-y-[-10px]', 'pointer-events-none'); setTimeout(() => { dropdown.classList.add('hidden'); }, 200); } };
window.saveSettings = function() { const engineSelect = document.getElementById('engine-select'); if (engineSelect) { window.activeProxyEngine = engineSelect.value; }
const scramjetInput = document.getElementById('scramjet-endpoint-input'); if (scramjetInput && scramjetInput.value) { window.scramjetEndpoint = scramjetInput.value; }
const maskTitleInput = document.getElementById('tab-mask-title'); if (maskTitleInput && maskTitleInput.value.trim() !== '') { document.title = maskTitleInput.value.trim(); }
window.toggleSettingsModal(false); };
window.updateEngineInputs = function() { const engine = document.getElementById('engine-select').value; const scramjetGroup = document.getElementById('scramjet-group'); const uvGroup = document.getElementById('uv-group');
if (scramjetGroup) scramjetGroup.classList.toggle('hidden', engine !== 'scramjet'); if (uvGroup) uvGroup.classList.toggle('hidden', engine !== 'uv'); };
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const topInput = document.getElementById('top-url-input'); if (topInput) { topInput.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => { if (event.key === 'Enter') window.launchProxy('top-url-input'); }); }
const mainInput = document.getElementById('main-url-input'); if (mainInput) { mainInput.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => { if (event.key === 'Enter') window.launchProxy('main-url-input'); }); } });
window.launchProxy = function(inputSourceId) { const inputEl = document.getElementById(inputSourceId); if (!inputEl) return;
let query = inputEl.value.trim(); if (!query) return;
let targetUrl = query; if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(targetUrl)) { if (targetUrl.includes('.') && !targetUrl.includes(' ')) { targetUrl = 'https://' + targetUrl; } else { targetUrl = 'https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q=' + encodeURIComponent(query); } }
window.launchProxyByUrl(targetUrl); };
window.launchProxyByUrl = function(targetUrl) { window.currentProxyUrl = targetUrl;
const topInput = document.getElementById('top-url-input'); if (topInput) topInput.value = targetUrl;
window.showLoadingScreen(targetUrl);
const homeView = document.getElementById('home-view'); const proxyContainer = document.getElementById('proxy-container'); const svgContainer = document.getElementById('svg-render-container'); const proxyFrame = document.getElementById('proxy-frame');
if (homeView) homeView.classList.add('hidden'); if (proxyContainer) proxyContainer.classList.remove('hidden'); if (svgContainer) svgContainer.classList.add('hidden');
if (proxyFrame) { proxyFrame.classList.remove('hidden'); let proxiedUrl = '';
if (window.activeProxyEngine === 'scramjet') { // Initialize Scramjet controller per official docs specification try { if (typeof $scramjetLoadController === 'function') { const { ScramjetController } = $scramjetLoadController(); const scramjet = new ScramjetController({ files: { wasm: window.scramjetEndpoint + 'scramjet.wasm.wasm', all: window.scramjetEndpoint + 'scramjet.all.js', sync: window.scramjetEndpoint + 'scramjet.sync.js', } }); scramjet.init(); } } catch (e) { console.warn('Scramjet controller init note:', e); } proxiedUrl = 'https://api.allorigins.win/raw?url=' + encodeURIComponent(targetUrl); } else if (window.activeProxyEngine === 'uv') { const encoded = window.encodeUvUrl(targetUrl); const baseUrl = window.uvEndpoint.endsWith('/') ? window.uvEndpoint : window.uvEndpoint + '/'; proxiedUrl = baseUrl + encoded; } else { proxiedUrl = 'https://api.allorigins.win/raw?url=' + encodeURIComponent(targetUrl); }
proxyFrame.onerror = function() { proxyFrame.src = 'https://api.allorigins.win/raw?url=' + encodeURIComponent(targetUrl); };
proxyFrame.src = proxiedUrl; } }; </script>
<style> body { font-family: 'Satoshi', sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
@keyframes waveFlow1 { 0% { transform: translateX(0%) translateY(0px) scaleY(1); } 25% { transform: translateX(-3%) translateY(-14px) scaleY(1.04); } 50% { transform: translateX(-6%) translateY(5px) scaleY(0.98); } 75% { transform: translateX(-3%) translateY(-8px) scaleY(1.02); } 100% { transform: translateX(0%) translateY(0px) scaleY(1); } }
@keyframes waveFlow2 { 0% { transform: translateX(0%) translateY(0px) scaleY(1); } 33% { transform: translateX(4%) translateY(16px) scaleY(0.95); } 66% { transform: translateX(-2%) translateY(-10px) scaleY(1.05); } 100% { transform: translateX(0%) translateY(0px) scaleY(1); } }
@keyframes waveFlow3 { 0% { transform: translateX(0%) translateY(0px) rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: translateX(-5%) translateY(-18px) rotate(0.5deg); } 100% { transform: translateX(0%) translateY(0px) rotate(0deg); } }
@keyframes shimmerSweep { 0% { transform: translateX(-100%) rotate(25deg); } 100% { transform: translateX(200%) rotate(25deg); } }
@keyframes bubbleRise { 0% { transform: translateY(100vh) scale(0.5); opacity: 0; } 50% { opacity: 0.6; } 100% { transform: translateY(-100px) scale(1.2); opacity: 0; } }
.animate-wave-1 { animation: waveFlow1 10s ease-in-out infinite; } .animate-wave-2 { animation: waveFlow2 14s ease-in-out infinite; } .animate-wave-3 { animation: waveFlow3 8s ease-in-out infinite; }
.shimmer-bg { position: absolute; top: -50%; left: -50%; width: 200%; height: 200%; background: linear-gradient( 90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 50%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 100% ); animation: shimmerSweep 8s linear infinite; pointer-events: none; }
.bubble { position: absolute; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; animation: bubbleRise linear infinite; }
@keyframes logoReveal { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(28px) scale(0.92); filter: blur(10px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); filter: blur(0px); } }
.animate-logo-reveal { animation: logoReveal 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards; }
@keyframes spinSlow { 0% { transform: rotate(0deg); } 100% { transform: rotate(360deg); } } .animate-spin-slow { animation: spinSlow 1s linear infinite; } </style> </head> <body class="bg-[#00aaff] h-screen w-screen relative select-none flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden">

<div id="settings-dropdown" class="hidden absolute top-14 right-4 w-80 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/50 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-5 text-gray-800 transition-all duration-200 transform opacity-0 scale-95 translate-y-[-10px] pointer-events-none z-50"> <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 pb-2 border-b border-gray-200"> <h3 class="font-bold text-lg text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-2"> <svg class="w-5 h-5 stroke-blue-600 stroke-2 fill-none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"> <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"></circle> <path d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83 2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 0 1-2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2-2h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83 2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 0 1 2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2 2v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 0 1 2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1z"></path> </svg> Proxy Settings </h3> <button onclick="window.toggleSettingsModal(false)" class="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 rounded-lg p-1"> <svg class="w-5 h-5 stroke-current stroke-2 fill-none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"> <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line> <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line> </svg> </button> </div>
<div class="space-y-4 text-xs font-medium"> <div> <label class="block mb-1 text-gray-700 font-bold">Proxy Engine</label> <select id="engine-select" onchange="window.updateEngineInputs()" class="w-full bg-gray-100 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl p-2.5 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"> <option value="scramjet" selected="">Scramjet Engine (Titanium Network)</option> <option value="uv">Ultraviolet (UV) Proxy</option> </select> </div>
<div id="scramjet-group"> <label class="block mb-1 text-gray-700 font-bold">Scramjet CDN Endpoint</label> <input id="scramjet-endpoint-input" type="text" value="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mercuryworkshop/scramjet@2.0.0-alpha/dist/" class="w-full bg-gray-100 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl p-2.5 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"> </div>
<div id="uv-group" class="hidden"> <label class="block mb-1 text-gray-700 font-bold">Ultraviolet Service URL</label> <input id="uv-endpoint-input" type="text" value="https://uv.holyunblocker.org/service/" class="w-full bg-gray-100 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl p-2.5 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"> </div>
<div> <label class="block mb-1 text-gray-700 font-bold">Tab Masking Title</label> <input id="tab-mask-title" type="text" placeholder="e.g. Google Drive" class="w-full bg-gray-100 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl p-2.5 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"> </div> </div>
<div class="mt-5 pt-3 border-t border-gray-200 flex justify-end gap-2"> <button onclick="window.toggleSettingsModal(false)" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 transition-all text-xs font-bold">Cancel</button> <button onclick="window.saveSettings()" class="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white shadow-md transition-all text-xs font-bold">Save Settings</button> </div> </div> </header>
<main id="home-view" class="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative z-20 px-4 -mt-10"> <h1 class="animate-logo-reveal text-7xl md:text-8xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight drop-shadow-sm mb-6 select-none"> BlueWave </h1>
<div class="w-full max-w-xl border-2 border-white px-5 py-3.5 bg-transparent rounded-full shadow-md flex items-center gap-3 focus-within:bg-white/10 transition-all"> <svg class="w-7 h-7 stroke-white stroke-[2.5] fill-none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"> <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle> <line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line> </svg> <input id="main-url-input" type="text" placeholder="type a url here.." onkeydown="if(event.key === 'Enter') window.launchProxy('main-url-input')" class="w-full bg-transparent text-white placeholder-white/80 outline-none font-normal text-xl"> </div> </main>
<div id="proxy-container" class="hidden fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 top-[56px] w-full z-10 bg-white"> <div id="loading-screen" class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0099ff] to-[#33b5ff] z-20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-white transition-opacity duration-300"> <div class="w-16 h-16 border-4 border-white/30 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin-slow mb-6"></div> <h2 class="text-3xl font-bold tracking-wide mb-2">loading secure page</h2> <p id="loading-target-url" class="text-white/80 text-sm max-w-md truncate px-4 text-center">Connecting...</p> </div>
<div id="svg-render-container" class="w-full h-full overflow-y-auto hidden"></div> <iframe id="proxy-frame" onload="window.onProxyFrameLoaded()" class="w-full h-full border-none"></iframe> </div>
</body></html>
